verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to a data-center GPU, but the evidence pack contains no published tensor throughput figures (TFLOPS/TOPS) with precision or sparsity stated. The only performance claims are relative marketing multipliers ("3X training, 15X inference" versus the previous generation), which is exactly the bare marketing number the story rejects. The memory (1,440 GB) and NVLink bandwidth (14.4 TB/s) specs are a different metric and cannot be used to size compute throughput.
